parameters.query: SELECT count(*)::int AS tablas FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema');

CREATE TEMP TABLE _rt (tablas bigint, filas bigint) ON COMMIT DROP; DO $$DECLARE tcount int; rcount bigint := 0; r record; c bigint;BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO tcount FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema'); FOR r IN SELECT format('%I.%I', table_schema, table_name) AS tbl FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') LOOP EXECUTE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' || r.tbl INTO c; rcount := rcount + c; END LOOP; INSERT INTO _rt VALUES (tcount, rcount); END$$; SELECT tablas, filas FROM _rt;
